name: EvolIF
description: EvolIF is an evolving benchmark framework designed to evaluate large language models' multi-turn instruction-following ability in multi-topic dialogues. It uses a three-layer tracking mechanism and query synthesis to mimic sequential user behaviors, incorporating process-centric metrics and terminating evaluation based on user patience, covering 12 constraint groups.
reputation: A recent benchmark framework for multi-turn instruction following that has seen some early research interest but limited broad adoption so far.
notes: Introduces process-centric metrics and an evolving framework to avoid saturation in multi-turn dialogue evaluation; publicly available resources.
